nodes.title: The Question card (and the trouble strip and the NumberPad tray) is sized to what it holds: the Desk measures [data-measure] bodies after every render and the solver grows the zone to fit (the spec heights are floors), taking the extra from tray → face (to faceMin) → caption → pad; never clipped. Reversal: a layout where the card's content is bounded by construction (e.g. a hard 2-line ask cap plus a chip that never wraps) so a fixed height provably fits at 360 and font scale 2.0

A fixed solved card height with overflow:hidden: at 360 it clipped the signals the card exists for (the 'Not sent yet' chip cut in half under T2/T4, the hint's 2nd line, the whole magnifier + 'Let's look again' chip in b2 not_yet: scrollHeight 173 > 102). V-LAYOUT-1 passed because it checked box positions, not content

Outbox: every attempt (the first too) carries turnSeq; turnSeq is per lesson and seeded from max(turnSeq) in the store (a reloaded page never overwrites a held record); records of other lessons are flushed when the next lesson starts (marked retried), that lesson is then closed; 409 'ended' / 404 drop them; > 24 h dropped unsent. Per-attempt 25 s deadline (abort → retryable). kick() = T1 'Try again' (abandon the attempt in flight, resend now); edit() = 'Fix' (same turnSeq, edited:true). Reversal: the lesson route dedupes and resumes by lid itself (a resume endpoint), so the client no longer needs to flush another lesson's answers

TextLink treated the media 'abort' event as a failed reply. Setting a new src on an element whose last clip had played fires 'abort' for the OLD resource as a queued task after the new handlers are set, so EVERY second text-lane reply was failed on arrival and the floor stuck in 'thinking' (found only on the shipped route: tests/e2e-design-b1-route.mjs; the dev harness's ScriptedLink never used an <audio>). 'abort' no longer fails a reply; error and the stall timer still do

Choosing the Keyboard layout from text-field focus alone: in a text-mode Older lesson the field autofocuses, so a laptop or a phone with no keyboard up got the 324 dp keyboard column (a 64 dp face and ~300 dp of dead paper above the dock). The Keyboard layout now needs a real on-screen keyboard (visualViewport inset > 120 dp)

Settling the floor inside the failed turn's catch: pendingTurns was still counted (it drops in finally), and the floor ignores a settle while a Director call is in flight, so after a held answer the dock said '{T} is thinking' under 'Your answer didn't send.' Now the settle is dispatched after the decrement, on every lane, and the dock word is suspended to 'Your answer is saved' while T2/T4 hold the answer

V-SIG-3/4 run at the spec's 6% bar on the dock + card region (the 0.5% bar was a deviation, not a measurement). Shape carriers added so state differs by more than colour: HEARD shows a solid receipt disc and no side controls; SPEAKING/SHOWING hold only the mic (the side controls come with YOUR TURN). The one pair exempted is yielding/your_turn (yielding IS your_turn arriving, ≤ 250 ms, same word by §4.2). Reversal: a yielding state that is actually triggered (a TurnClock) and seen long enough to need its own look

'Hear the question' replays the stored teacher turn that POSED the pinned ask (its TTS seq, from the bridge clip buffer, else fetched again by seq), never her last turn (a hint or praise); a second tap within 10 s sends the REPEAT-SLOW request ('slower' chip) instead of time-stretching. Reversal: the server exposes TTS of ui.ask.spoken (an /api/tts by ask), so the exact question can be replayed without her preamble

PROPOSED for the owner (not decided here): the B1 Desk stays the default lesson UI rather than going behind VITE_UI_V2=1 as §14 says. The old lesson UI was deleted by the B1 build and already merged; restoring it to flag it would put two lesson UIs in the tree. Open acceptance rows: B1-A5 (director-sim lints), B1-A7 (baselines not human-approved), B1-A11 (prod smoke), lint-ui not in verify-release (264 findings in other owners' files). Reversal: the owner wants the flag, or a B1 acceptance row fails in the prod smoke

B1 fixer batteries (headless Chromium/SwiftShader, n=1 run each): dev harness tests/e2e-design-b1.mjs and the shipped route tests/e2e-design-b1-route.mjs (built SPA via server/serve.mjs, API mocked by page.route). Route: 0 clipped card/strip/dock frames across Older 360/1280 × light/dark and Young 360/1280; 0 long tasks > 50 ms in 10 s of YOUR TURN with the live face at 360 (V-PERF-1 bar ≤ 2); every turn carried turnSeq; T4 'Send again' and T2→RC delivered

md.decisions:
## b1-card-sized-to-content
The Desk measures `[data-measure="card"]`, `[data-measure="strip"]` and `[data-measure="tray"]` (the NumberPad) after every render (useLayoutEffect + ResizeObserver + fonts.ready) and reports cardNeed / stripNeed / trayNeed with the container size. `solveDesk` treats the §6.3.4 heights as floors: card = max(spec, need), strip = max(estimate, need), Work tray ≥ max(trayMin, need). The extra height is taken tray → face (to faceMin) → caption → pad, then the tray below its floor (a strip is transient; the dock must stay on screen); still short → overflow (the Desk scrolls). Strip actions are full targets (48 dp Older, 64 dp Young) and wrap under the sentence. Why: a fixed card clipped the answer chip, the verdict line and the hint at 360. Reversal: a card whose content is bounded by construction.

## b1-outbox-turnseq-always
src/lesson/outbox.ts: `reserve(lessonId)` seeds from the store; every attempt sends `turnSeq`; resends add `retried: true`; `edit()` adds `edited: true` under the same turnSeq; a per-attempt deadline (25 s) aborts a hung request (retryable); `kick()` abandons the attempt in flight or the wait before the next retry. src/lesson/runtime.ts: `retryNow()` (T1 Try again), `fixAnswer()` (Fix), `flushOthers()` at start (answers held for an earlier lesson are sent, marked retried, and that lesson closed; 409 ended / 404 drop; > 24 h dropped), the `online` event kicks a sleeping retry (RC within 3 s). OPEN for the lesson route owner: dedupe on (lessonId, turnSeq) and treat `edited: true` as superseding the earlier attempt; accept late turns for a lesson closed by page-hide, or held answers of that lesson are dropped on the 409.

## b1-vsig3-6pct-restored
The battery's V-SIG-3/4 bar is back to 6% of the dock + card region, as §13.2 says. Heard shows a solid ink receipt disc in place of the mic and hides the side controls for its 400-600 ms; speaking/showing hide the side controls (the mic stays for barge-in). Deviation: the yielding/your_turn pair is exempt (one signal in two phases).

## b1-hear-replays-posing-turn
LessonState gains replySeq/replyText (set just before the ui of the turn they came with); the pinned Ask records them; UiBridge clips carry their TTS seq and `replay(slower, seq)` picks that clip. Fallback: `runtime.replayReply({text, seq})` speaks the stored turn again (text lanes), then her last clip.

## b1-ui-v2-flag-not-restored
Proposed, needs the owner. See the title for the open acceptance rows.
md.measurements:
## b1-fix-battery-2026-10-03
Run logs: docs/design/build/b1/fix/run-dev-2026-10-03.log and docs/design/build/b1/fix/run-route-2026-10-03.log. Method: headless Chromium (SwiftShader), 360 × 640 DPR 2 touch and 1280 × 800, light and dark; the dev battery drives /dev/desk fixtures and the live harness (REAL LessonRuntime/outbox/floor/signals; Director and voice simulated); the route battery builds the production SPA, serves it with server/serve.mjs and mocks /api/* (scripted Director, a 0.9 s silent WAV per stored turn). V-PERF-1: PerformanceObserver('longtask') over 10 s of YOUR TURN on the route with the live face: 0 long tasks (n=1, SwiftShader; relative only). Not a device or child measurement.
md.rejected:
## b1-rejected-fixed-card-height
Measured in /dev/desk at 360: .dk-card scrollHeight > clientHeight in not_yet (b2 173>102, b3 185>114, b1 184>154), partial, with-help, hint-line, board-not_yet, keyboard, T2, T4 (b2 142>102, b3 144>114) and heard/thinking/T1/RC/correct on b2.

## b1-rejected-textlink-onabort
Trace on the built route: reply 2's play() rejected 'interrupted by a call to pause()' after an 'abort' event at src change; TextLink.stop('failed') ran from the onabort handler. Every second reply in a text-lane lesson was silent and the floor never left 'thinking'.

## b1-rejected-keyboard-from-focus
On the built route at 360, a text-mode Older lesson rendered the 324 dp Keyboard column with no keyboard: SpeechRow face, card, ~300 dp of empty paper, a 92 dp dock that clipped its header.

## b1-rejected-settle-before-decrement
floor.ts ignores `settle` while `turnInFlight()`; runtime.ts dispatched it in the chain's catch, before `.finally` decremented pendingTurns.
